items.headline: SoftBank's $20B junk-bond roadshow launches into a 'congested' AI-debt market as funding costs climb
items.note: Citi/Goldman/JPMorgan/Morgan Stanley began marketing SoftBank's up-to-$20B BB+ bond in New York on Sept 14 to refinance the $25.9B OpenAI bridge-loan balance due Sept 15, right after SoftBank's ¥1tn retail bond priced at the top of its range (4.75%) — a concrete sign that AI-megadeal debt is getting pricier and harder to place as ~$220B of AI-adjacent supply has already hit the market this year.

items.headline: Oracle raises FY2026 restructuring/layoff cost estimate by $700M, tied to AI-driven headcount cuts
items.note: Oracle disclosed on Sept 12 that severance/exit costs will push its restructuring plan about $700M higher (~$2.8B total), adding to cash outflows at a company already running deeply negative free cash flow (-$5.4B in Q1) while funding its AI data-center buildout with debt.
